About.title: About meridian
About.lede: meridian is a UK-built weather dashboard for the places you actually care about — honest forecasts, clear limits, and no account wall for the basics.
About.whatBody1: meridian helps you track live conditions, hourly detail, and a longer outlook for home, work, family, and travel. Pin a short list of places in your browser, open any city worldwide from search, and read forecasts without signing up for a weather social network.
About.whatBody2: We also publish a journal of practical forecast guides, UK place pages with live conditions, and optional email digests or alerts when you want them. The product is built as a progressive web app so you can install it on your phone or desktop when that helps.
About.dataBody1: Forecasts and observations are powered by OpenWeather. meridian caches responses carefully so a shared free-tier key lasts through a busy day, and we stay honest about what the free upstream window can and cannot provide — especially further out in a 10-day view.
About.dataBody2: Place pages may also show OpenStreetMap “things to do” nearby and, where we have published them, original Meridian guides. We do not scrape news article bodies; optional local headlines are title-and-link only when a feed is configured.
About.whoBody: {trading} is a trading name of {company}, a company registered in England and Wales. We build and host meridianweather.co.uk for people who want a calm, multi-city weather tool with transparent monetisation.
About.whoBody2: Questions about privacy, data, or the product: privacy@meridianweather.co.uk. Company details and policies live under Legal in the site footer.
About.adsBody: Advertising only loads after you opt in to advertising cookies. You can also remove ads with a paid ad-free option when Stripe billing is configured. We do not sell personal weather lists; pins stay in your browser unless you choose email features.

Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.description: Straight answers about forecasts, data sources, ads, alerts, and how meridian works.

whatIs.a: meridian is a multi-city weather dashboard and UK place-forecast site. Check live conditions, hourly and longer outlooks, pin places in your browser, and optionally subscribe to digests or alerts.

accuracy.a: No consumer forecast is perfect. Near-term hours are usually more reliable than day nine. meridian shows OpenWeather data with clear tabs so you can lean on hourly detail when plans are close, and treat the far end of a 10-day view as a direction of travel.

dataSource.q: Where does the weather data come from?
dataSource.a: OpenWeather supplies the underlying observations and forecasts. meridian formats, caches, and presents that data. Icons are local Meridian/Meteocon assets mapped from OpenWeather condition codes.

ukCoverage.q: Do you cover the whole UK?
ukCoverage.a: You can search worldwide. We also maintain a seeded set of UK /weather place pages for SEO and local context. Coverage quality depends on OpenWeather for that lat/lon — not on a separate Meridian climate model.

ads.a: Ads help fund the free tier. The AdSense script loads only after you accept advertising consent. Without consent, you see branded placeholders or an ad-free layout depending on configuration.

consent.q: What does the cookie banner control?
consent.a: Essential storage keeps your cities and preferences. Functional consent allows weather cache in localStorage. Analytics and advertising are optional and off until you opt in.

alerts.q: How do email digests and alerts work?
alerts.a: Digests are calm weekly summaries for places you follow. Alerts fire when thresholds you configure are crossed. Both are opt-in and include unsubscribe links. Availability depends on an email connector being configured on the host.

account.a: No account is required to search, pin places locally, or read forecasts. Admin login is for operators only. Email features use the address you provide for that mailing list.

places.a: They are location pages with live conditions for a named place, plus optional things-to-do from OpenStreetMap and any published Meridian guide. Thin auto-generated filler guides are not published for advertising review.

adFree.a: Yes, when Stripe billing is configured: Settings → Remove ads. If billing is not available on the host, the UI says so rather than offering a broken checkout.

languages.a: The interface chrome is translated for several locales. Editorial pages for AdSense review emphasise English (en / en-GB). Weather numbers still come from OpenWeather with a matching language where supported.

contact.a: Privacy and product questions: privacy@meridianweather.co.uk. Legal entity details are in the footer and on the About page.
